title.narrative: Empowered learners for healthy, sustainable, creative and responsible societies

description.narrative: Eastern Africa encounters multiple challenges in promoting sustainable development, peace and including poverty, climate change leading to drought, flooding, food security, conflicts, violent extremism, and the rise of hate speech, misinformation, mal-information, and disinformation. It is therefore critical to strengthen the role of ESD and GCED in nurturing responsible citizens to actively contribute to Health and well-being, peace, social cohesion, inclusion, climate resilience, and sustainability of communities and societies. The activity aims to contribute to the implementation of SDG target 4.7 in Eastern Africa by promoting transformative approaches to education at all levels from early learners to higher education through lifelong learning to nurture competencies for living together in peace and preserving the planet. Hence, the strategy adopted ensures that learners are empowered to lead healthy lives, promote sustainable development, and engage with the world as creative and responsible global citizens.
